results_note: Exploratory, F&O results meetings of Oct 2026 (n = 119 to 151 by measure): the stock moved about twice as far as usual (median 3.3% from D-1 to D+1 against 1.6%), and options priced more too. An ATM straddle bought at D-1's close and sold at D+1's had a median of -10.8% and a mean of +2.5% before costs, against +1.3% for the control: the difference is not significant (t 0.3), and both lose after a 4% round trip. The label compares the move the options price today with the company's own past results moves (NSE's calendar only), and names cheap or rich only when the gap is outside what a fairly priced company would show by chance 90% of the time with that few events. A hypothesis, not a tested rule.
